Review this approach: we're adding a retry decorator that catches network errors and waits 2x the previous delay. Would you merge this?
Looks solid — exponential backoff is the right pattern for network retries. I'd suggest one tweak: cap the max delay so we don't wait forever. Otherwise I'd merge it as-is.
Summarize the key differences between LoRA and full fine-tuning in a few sentences.

LoRA freezes the base model and only trains small 'adapter' matrices layered on top. Full fine-tuning updates every weight in the model. LoRA is cheaper (tiny trainable params), faster, and you can swap adapters like plugins. Full fine-tuning gives more flexibility but needs way more compute and VRAM.

Draft a GitHub PR description for a change that adds unit tests for the data loading module.

## What changed

Added unit tests for the data loading module (`data.py`).

## Why

The data loader had no test coverage, which made refactoring risky. These tests verify that JSONL files are loaded correctly and that the chat template is applied as expected.

## Testing

Ran `uv run pytest tests/test_data.py` — all 8 tests passing.
